selection_procedure.name: fixed_sequence_exact_binomial
selection_procedure.test: For each candidate in strictest-to-laxest order, test H0:p_bad(tau)>=epsilon against p_bad(tau)<epsilon using an exact one-sided binomial test at level delta.
selection_procedure.stop_rule: Stop at the first candidate not certified; select the last candidate that passed.
selection_procedure.no_certified_threshold: Keep tau unset for that category and route to ensemble.
selection_procedure.category_guarantee: Per category only; simultaneous all-category claims require additional category-level multiplicity control.

notes: Template only: no calibration equations or numeric tau are approved by this manifest.
Declare category_list and the finite candidate_tau_values in strictly increasing order (strictest to laxest) before examining calibration outcomes.
epsilon is the tolerated bad-route probability; delta is the family-wise error rate for the fixed-sequence threshold family. Both are separate protocol choices.
Count each independent equation or defensible equation family once; seeds, noise levels, and repeated runs of one equation are not independent trials.
Guarantee is per category. Simultaneous certification claims across categories require a separate multiplicity procedure.
Applying the calibration guarantee to Core-15 assumes exchangeability/representativeness of Core-15 relative to the declared calibration population.
Do not populate this file with Core-15 equations or held-out/extrapolation outcomes.
Bad-route definition, including absolute edge R2 floor and relative ensemble margin, must be frozen before calibration.
Ready manifests must record SHA-256 hashes for each equation source, canonical formula, and training-row dataset, plus calibration data-manifest hash, code commit, and evaluator version.

bad_route_definition.edge_rows: Upper 20% of training rows ordered by projection onto first PCA direction; freeze exact construction/evaluator before calibration.
bad_route_definition.invalid_or_missing_scores: Fail closed; never drop silently or count as a successful route.
